notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis: Exhibit E Total Governmental Funds 2022 column (p4); roll on fund balances 386,451 + 651,262 - 641,696 + 121,163 - 121,163 - 553 = 395,464. Principal (552) and interest (1) paid on long-term liabilities are printed under Other financing sources (uses), so they are in other_financing. Governmental cash (cash and cash equivalents + cash with county treasurer) and certificates of deposit (investments) from Exhibit C (p3), 2021 comparative column for beginning. Taxes 181,475 split per Schedule 2 (p8; nonmajor funds have no taxes); Intergovernmental revenues 125,444 split per Schedule 2 (p8; nonmajor intergovernmental 0). Materials and services sold & refunds split by fund column (p4 General, pp11-12 nonmajor) as in FY2023. Statement capital outlay prints no function: labelled Capital Outlay; Street Fund capital outlay takes Streets/Highways from the fund column. Business-type accrual (Exhibit H Totals, p6; expenses total as on the Statement of Activities p2), measure net position, no transfers. Proprietary cash flows from Exhibit I (p7). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position 2022 (p1), capital assets and debt included. Detail: Schedule 2 (p8) General and Street; nonmajor combining (pp11-12) per fund column (10 funds; public safety = Firemen + Ambulance + Marshall, sanitation = Garbage, culture and recreation = the rest, all tie to Exhibit E); proprietary per fund from Exhibit H (p6), interest lines outside the operating totals. Schedules 5, 6 and 7 (pp13-15, budget comparisons by fund type in total) are less detailed and not recorded. Read pages 1-15 of 15
